name: What are the key metrics to track when evaluating the success of an AEO Content Strategy?
description: Key AEO success metrics include impressions/clicks from featured snippets, organic traffic to answer-focused content, engagement rates, and conversions.

mainEntity.name: What are the key metrics to track when evaluating the success of an AEO Content Strategy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Key metrics for evaluating an AEO Content Strategy include monitoring impressions and clicks from featured snippets, 'People Also Ask' boxes, and direct answers in search results. Tracking organic traffic increases for specific answer-focused content is also crucial. Beyond traffic, analyze engagement metrics like bounce rate and time on page for AEO-optimized content, as well as conversion rates if relevant. You should also observe changes in brand visibility and authority, as AEO aims to position your business as a trusted source for answers. Finally, keep an eye on your share of voice in voice search results.
